column2: The peasants of [Root.GetName] have risen, led by a hard-bitten old soldier who came home from the wars with nothing but scars and grievances. They have burned the tithe barns, strung up the bailiff and now have the nerve to demand their freedom!
Blasted traitors!

The peasants of [From.GetName] have risen, led by a hard-bitten old soldier who came home from the wars with nothing but scars and grievances. They have burned the tithe barns, strung up the bailiff and now have the nerve to demand their freedom!
More peasants have taken up their pitchforks and billhooks in [Root.GetName], swelling the ranks of the rebels!
Treacherous rabble!
More peasants have taken up their pitchforks and billhooks in [From.GetName], swelling the ranks of the rebels!

Fanatics of [Root.Religion.GetName] have risen in [Root.GetName], whipped into a frenzy by a wild-eyed preacher who swears the true faith has been betrayed. If they are not swiftly crushed, the heresy will spread like wildfire!
Accursed heretics!

Fanatics of [From.Religion.GetName] have risen in [From.GetName], whipped into a frenzy by a wild-eyed preacher who swears the true faith has been betrayed. If they are not swiftly crushed, the heresy will spread like wildfire!
Another mob of raving zealots has risen in [Root.GetName], flagellating themselves bloody as they march to join the uprising!
Curse these madmen!
Another mob of raving zealots has risen in [From.GetName], flagellating themselves bloody as they march to join the uprising!

A dangerous revolt has broken out in [Root.GetName]. The old [Root.Culture.GetName] landholders have dug their grandfathers' banners out of the chests, armed their tenants and hired proper soldiers to drill them. They mean to restore the [Root.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!
Worrisome...

A dangerous revolt has broken out in [From.GetName]. The old [From.Culture.GetName] landholders have dug their grandfathers' banners out of the chests, armed their tenants and hired proper soldiers to drill them. They mean to restore the [From.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!
More [Root.Culture.GetName] rebels have taken up arms in [Root.GetName], joining the struggle to restore the [Root.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!
More [From.Culture.GetName] rebels have taken up arms in [From.GetName], joining the struggle to restore the [From.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName]!

The faithful of [Root.Religion.GetName] have risen in [Root.GetName], led by a militant [Root.Religion.GetPriestTitle] who preaches that the land must be won back for the true gods. If they are not swiftly crushed, this revolt could spread like wildfire!
Curses!
Accursed unbelievers!

The faithful of [From.Religion.GetName] have risen in [From.GetName], led by a militant [From.Religion.GetPriestTitle] who preaches that the land must be won back for the true gods. If they are not swiftly crushed, this revolt could spread like wildfire!
Another howling mob of [Root.Religion.GetName] faithful has risen in [Root.GetName], reinforcing the uprising!
Heathen scum!
Another howling mob of [From.Religion.GetName] faithful has risen in [From.GetName], reinforcing the uprising!
The rebels have broken down my door and stream into the room with torches, cleavers and boar spears. There is no use pleading for my life. I will go out fighting!
Die, you bastards! Arrgh...

The rebels have broken down my door and stream into the room with torches, cleavers and boar spears. They hack and stab at me until their arms tire, and still I stand. One by one they drop their weapons and flee, screaming.
Run, rabble. Run.
Rebels killed §Y[From.GetTitledName]§! after taking §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! in §Y[FromFrom.County.GetName]§!.
They will all hang for this!
Rising of the [Root.County.GetAdjective] Clans

A lesser clan has risen in [Root.GetName]. Its chieftain has painted the clan's marks on every tent-pole from here to the horizon and sworn before the shamans that the clan will no longer ride at the back of the horde. They demand a place among the great clans, and they have brought their horses and their bows to argue the point!

A lesser herd has risen in [Root.GetName]. Its chieftain has gored the old herd-leader's messenger, smeared the herdstone with fresh blood and bellowed that the herd will no longer eat the leavings of its betters. The gors are stamping and braying. They demand a place among the great herds!
We shall see who proves the stronger!

A lesser clan has risen in [From.GetName]. Its chieftain has painted the clan's marks on every tent-pole from there to the horizon and sworn before the shamans that the clan will no longer ride at the back of the horde. They demand a place among the great clans!

A lesser herd has risen in [From.GetName]. Its chieftain has smeared the herdstone with fresh blood and bellowed that the herd will no longer eat the leavings of its betters. They demand a place among the great herds!
More riders have come over to the rising in [Root.GetName]. Kinsmen of the rebel chieftain, young bloods with nothing to lose and outcasts from other clans swell the rebel host!
More riders have come over to the rising in [From.GetName]. Kinsmen of the rebel chieftain, young bloods with nothing to lose and outcasts from other clans swell the rebel host!
The rebel mob ravaging [Root.GetName] is putting everything it cannot carry to the torch. Mills, granaries and storehouses go up in flames, and the smoke can be seen for miles!
Is there anything they won't destroy?
Bad news, but at least it is not my holding burning...
The rebel mob ravaging [From.GetName] has put my holding to the torch. What they could not carry off, they burned!
The rebels holding [Root.Location.GetName] have caught me on the road. They drag me from my horse with billhooks and boar spears, and there are far too many of them!
They will kill me?!
Damn these rebels!
I am lucky to be alive...
[From.GetTitledName] has been caught and butchered by the rebels holding [From.Location.GetName]!
How dare they murder one of mine!

My liege,

I was ambushed by a mob of rebels and barely got away with my life. The attack has left me maimed, and I fear for myself and all those around me in [From.Location.GetName]. These rebels must be stopped.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
They must indeed.

My liege,

I escaped with my life, but the mob of rebels that fell on me left me wounded. I fear these attacks will only grow worse until the revolt in [From.Location.GetName] is put down.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
This rabble must be stopped!
Feeling little loyalty to their far-off ruler, the rebels of [Root.GetName] have thrown open the gates and sworn themselves to another lord!
Treachery!
Tired of their old ruler, the rebels of [Root.GetName] have thrown open the gates and sworn themselves to me!
Excellent! Or is it...?
Feeling little loyalty to their far-off ruler, the rebels of [FromFrom.GetName] have thrown open the gates and sworn themselves to [From.County.Holder.GetTitledName]!
Damn these peasants!

The rebels have broken down my door and stream into the room with torches, cleavers and boar spears. I fight, but they drag me down and hack at me until someone shouts that the loot is getting away. They leave me in my own blood, maimed for life.
Damn these rebels!
The rebels have broken down my door and stream into the room with torches, cleavers and boar spears. A blade opens my side before I fight my way out through the smoke. I live, but the wound is deep.
I am lucky to be alive...
Rebels maimed §Y[From.GetTitledName]§! after taking §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! in §Y[FromFrom.County.GetName]§!.
Rebels wounded §Y[From.GetTitledName]§! after taking §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! in §Y[FromFrom.County.GetName]§!.
The rebels who took [revolt_burned_holding.GetName] have put it to the torch. What they could not carry off, they burned!

Beneath the sands of [Root.GetName] a tomb has opened. A prince of ancient Nehekhara, woken by some slight or some forgotten oath, has risen with his household guard of bone and bronze and claims these lands as his by right of a dynasty dead three thousand years.
A big greenskin in [Root.GetName] has decided he is da boss now. He has knocked down everyone who said otherwise, and the ladz who are left are following him to go and krump the old boss.
Another rival. They never stop.
A prince of the tombs has risen in [From.GetName], with a host of the restless dead behind him. He claims the county for himself.
A new boss has risen in [From.GetName] and gathered a mob to take the county for himself.
Restless Tomb Host
Restless
Upstart Boss's Mob
Upstart
